invalidate.title: Remove Participant
invalidate.warning: This invalidates all eligible active tickets for this participant. It does not refund payments, charge the participant, release capacity, renumber tickets, or remove participant history.
invalidate.alreadyInvalid: {{count}} already invalidated ticket(s) will be preserved unchanged.
invalidate.largeOperation: This participant has {{count}} eligible tickets. The operation will run in safe batches and only report success when all eligible tickets are processed.

invalidate.partialRetry: Processed {{processed}} ticket(s), but {{remaining}} ticket(s) remain. Retry to continue this participant removal.
invalidate.partialBlocked: Processed {{processed}} ticket(s), but {{remaining}} ticket(s) remain. The competition is now protected, so the remaining tickets cannot be invalidated.
invalidate.manualReview: This operation is partially complete. No automatic rollback is performed. Record the operation ID and counts and escalate for manual review; do not retry while the competition is protected.
invalidate.finalityBlocked: This competition has reached a protected draw or winner state. Tickets cannot be invalidated.
invalidate.winnerBlocked: A winning ticket was found for this user. Winner tickets cannot be invalidated.
invalidate.noActive: There are no active tickets eligible for invalidation.
invalidate.remainingSelected: {{count}} other active ticket(s) will remain active.

invalidate.nothing: No tickets needed to be invalidated.

invalidate.modeBlock: Remove and block from this competition
invalidate.modeBlockHint: Invalidates active tickets and prevents this participant from buying or receiving more tickets in this competition. Their account and other competitions are unaffected.
invalidate.warningBlock: This invalidates all eligible active tickets and blocks this participant from future purchases and ticket fulfillment in this competition. It does not refund payments, charge the participant, release capacity, renumber tickets, or remove participant history. Outstanding payment links are expired where possible.
invalidate.blockNoActive: There are no active tickets to invalidate, but the participant will still be blocked from this competition.
invalidate.confirmCheckboxBlock: I understand this blocks the participant from this competition, does not issue a refund, charges nothing, and does not disable their account.
invalidate.successBlock: Removed and blocked the participant from this competition after invalidating {{count}} ticket(s).
invalidate.nothingBlock: Participant blocked from this competition. No tickets needed to be invalidated.

revoke.title: Revoke Unused Bonus Tickets
revoke.eligibility: This row shows {{total}} total credit(s): {{used}} used, {{revoked}} revoked, {{eligible}} currently revocable. This action will submit exactly {{selected}} unused credit(s). Credits already redeemed into tickets are never revoked.
revoke.blockedNotice: This request could not be processed safely. Close this dialog and reopen it after the credit data has refreshed before trying again.
revoke.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why these credits are being revoked
revoke.partialNotice: Revocation is resumable: retrying re-rolls the remaining credits safely without double-decrementing the balance.
revoke.driftNotice: The stored free_tickets balance could not support the full decrement; revocation stopped without producing a negative balance.
revoke.balanceInvalidNotice: The stored balance is invalid; revocation stopped without decrement. Resolve the balance and retry after reconciliation.
revoke.nothingRevoked: No credits were revoked in this request.
revoke.nothingToRevoke: No credits needed to be revoked; the requested credits are already redeemed or revoked.
revoke.skippedRedeemed: Skipped {{count}} credit(s) already redeemed into competition tickets.
revoke.stateChangeNotice: Credit state changed after prevalidation; the affected credits are excluded.
revoke.excludedNotice: {{count}} credit(s) could not be revoked because their state changed (ownership/reward type/missing); they are excluded from this retry.
revoke.reconcileNotice: The balance requires reconciliation before the remaining credits can be safely revoked. Retrying without fixing the balance will not succeed.
